items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: Eddie Morris on trombone. That was a six piece band too.

ctx.x: Did you play second trumpet or were you playing bass then?

Well, no, I wasn't playing bass then. I was playing trumpet. Trumpet. Trumpet. Yeah. And they had, uh, Eddie Morris was playing trombone. Oh, yeah. Eddie Morris on trombone. That was a six piece band too. Punch was good too in that time. It was fast singing. I used to love a young play. And, uh, I played at Lee Collins a lot of time on parades. Whose band was that?
Do you remember? Was there any special band like Onrigger Tuxedo or one of those organized bands? Or just a makeup band?
